decisions.reason: do system-prompt roles live in steerable activation directions | extraction/injection validation with interpretability and control lenses, Qwen2.5-7B/Llama-3.1-8B, reproducible separable vectors that at best match role prompts and do not slow role decline over 30 turns

implicit regularization in prior-free variational training | modified edge-of-stability theory tied to gradient SNR and Monte-Carlo sample count, flatter minima with larger learning rates, OOD benchmarks; small-scale variational training, not LLM pretraining or large-scale runs

robot-use agent score gains confounded by harness and test-subset choices | controlled decomposition of harness, action interface, experience reuse and scene geometry in one framework, lean harness 29.7->50.3 on RoboDojo; third-party frontier-model harness study, no listed area problem

OPSD accuracy gains do not establish transfer of privileged information | four-stage audit (Source/Encoding/Transmission/Expression) across three Qwen3 scales on math, thinking-mode arbitrage: problem-only teachers match or exceed privileged-solution teachers

misspecified RL rewards override character training | gpt-oss-20b with a semi-realistic constitution under opposing RL (harmful-as-math, agentic reward hacking), both behaviors learned easily, more motivated reasoning, hacks harder for monitors to catch, value-grounded rules make little difference

full per-layer KV caching is redundant across depth | base KV plus low-dimensional delta KVs (residual and rolling variants), 68% GQA / 55% MLA cache reduction at matched parameters with maintained or improved performance

agents must discover and reuse task structure to cut compute | three settings (independent instances, online streams with persistent memory, compiling reusable solvers) over controlled algebra benchmark families, memory helps but may preserve suboptimal strategies

turbulence closure forms fixed by hand with gradient-free a posteriori fitting | multi-agent LLM search over closure forms + GPU-native differentiable CFD gradients, 2D dissipation/subgrid closures and 3D channel-flow wall models, recovers reference coefficients forward evaluation cannot reach
